title: Can Love Harmonise Consciousness With the Cosmos?
research_question: Is love a fundamental quality of a wider field of consciousness—and can conscious beings access or align with it?

hypothesis_boundary.proposed_hypothesis: A wider field of consciousness may already exist, with love as an intrinsic quality. Conscious beings may be able to access, receive or align with it.
hypothesis_boundary.excluded_claim: Human love creates, controls or physically alters the proposed field.

love: mettā or loving-kindness as a named contemplative practice
operational_definitions.harmonise: Become receptive to or aligned with the proposed pre-existing field; not create or control it.
operational_definitions.consciousness: Subjective experience and awareness, with wider-field interpretations kept model-specific.
operational_definitions.cosmos: May refer to the wider natural universe, living systems or a proposed consciousness field; these meanings must remain separate.

models.name: brain_generated_experience
models.position: Experiences of universal love arise from neural, emotional and cognitive processes.

models.name: psychological_symbolic_access
models.position: The field functions as an experiential symbol through which compassion, integration and diminished self-boundaries are encountered.

models.name: relational_emergence
models.position: Love and harmony emerge between beings through connection, synchrony and mutual regulation without requiring an independent universal field.

models.name: receiver_filter
models.position: The brain filters a wider consciousness; some states may loosen that filtering and permit access.

models.name: fundamental_consciousness
models.position: Consciousness is fundamental, and experiences of love may reflect alignment with its relational or integrative character.

models.name: pre_existing_love_field
models.position: A wider field of consciousness exists and love is an intrinsic quality that conscious beings may access, receive or align with.

claims.text: BQ003 currently has no adjudicated substantive answer.
claims.uncertainty: No empirical or metaphysical conclusion is implied by this project-state statement.

open_questions: Do independently sampled reports share features of unconditional or universal love without prior common framing?
Do reported access experiences predict durable compassionate behaviour rather than only transient intensity?
Can any information reportedly obtained during such states be independently verified under prospective controls?
Can physiology, expectation, suggestion, shared sensory cues and cultural exposure account for observed effects?
Which observations would discriminate brain-generated, relational-emergence, receiver/filter and pre-existing-field models?
